question: Tell me the most purchased other products and their quantities by customers who bought the Google Red Speckled Tee each month for the three months starting from November 2020.
sql:
WITH red_tee_transactions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT event_date, ecommerce.transaction_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(items) i
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20210131'
    AND event_name = 'purchase'
    AND LOWER(i.item_name) = 'google red speckled tee'
),
all_items_in_red_tee_purchases AS (
  SELECT 
    r.event_date, 
    r.transaction_id,
    i.item_name,
    i.quantity
  FROM red_tee_transactions r
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*` e
    ON r.transaction_id = e.ecommerce.transaction_id
    AND r.event_date = e.event_date
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(e.items) i
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20210131'
    AND e.event_name = 'purchase'
    AND LOWER(i.item_name) != 'google red speckled tee'
    AND LOWER(i.item_name) != '(not set)'
    AND i.item_name IS NOT NULL
    AND i.quantity IS NOT NULL
    AND i.quantity > 0
),
monthly_item_quantities AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date), MONTH) as purchase_month,
    item_name,
    SUM(quantity) as total_quantity
  FROM all_items_in_red_tee_purchases
  GROUP BY purchase_month, item_name
)
SELECT purchase_month, item_name, total_quantity
FROM monthly_item_quantities
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY purchase_month ORDER BY total_quantity DESC) = 1
ORDER BY purchase_month
